title: Disappointed with Strange Statue...
text: After getting Marvel Studios/Disney+ I thought about cancelling the subscription. But I wanted to give it one more chance. My Dr. Strange box didn't arrive until June 19th 2022. I saw a leaked video and I was so excited to receive this box. But it was not without flaws. The paint on the Supreme Statue was too dark in some places and missing in others. The left side of his collar was pressed against is face. I'm trying to place a folded napkin between the collar and face. I hope it stays apart. The Dr. Strange 1012 was perfect. I really wanted the Statue for my collection. I guess it's better than no box at all. This would have been my favorite Marvel Collector Box. .....So far the collar is holding. But it's slowly folding back to his face.
label: neutral
